scope: Rounded 26x31x14mm case, 24x27x0.8mm six-layer PCB; 100mAh candidate pack; continuous 16h target

reviewed.result: Seven pins agree with TDK DS-000383 rev1.1. JLC description incorrectly/ambiguously says SMD-5P: supplier package confirmation required.
Push-pull variant and pin mapping agree with TI. Do not substitute TLV7042 open-drain without redesign.

10kohm fixed TS with independent temperature monitoring is supported; TS low disables charging. External NTC window and MCU enable are present. This is not qualification of battery temperature limits.
Pin mapping consistent. 200mA regulator and battery dropout require peak-current budget and effective-capacitance check.

Old board has no copper zones and excessive USB detours; C16/U4 and C22/U8 decoupling distances approximately17/19mm. Passives relocated and U2/U10 moved; rerouting underway. DRC alone does not validate return paths.
OE tied to V1V8 means power-up high-impedance timing is not independently controlled. Review with rail ramp and GPIO state; TI recommends OE low until rails stable. Short signal paths required.
